  along=xx*np.cos(th)+yy*np.sin(th);perp=-xx*np.sin(th)+yy*np.cos(th)
  distance=np.hypot(np.maximum(abs(along)-L/2,0),perp)

 along=xx*np.cos(th)+yy*np.sin(th);perp=-xx*np.sin(th)+yy*np.cos(th)
 mask=(np.hypot(np.maximum(abs(along)-L/2,0),perp)<=2.8)
 gy=yy+cy;gx=xx+cx;sel=mask&(gy>=0)&(gy<N)&(gx>=0)&(gx<N)

   M[:,:int(np.ceil(dx))]=-1e9;M[:,N-int(np.ceil(dx)):]=-1e9

 cand=candidate_maps(CL);taken=np.zeros((N,N),bool);n=0

# Preview geometry in a compact image.
